_comment: Hand-curated agency metadata. This file is NEVER written by the generator —
edit it freely. scripts/fetch-filings.mjs merges it with live Federal Register
Every agency listed here is always shown on the dashboard, even with zero
filings, so the compliance gap stays visible. Agencies NOT listed here still
Fields: abbr, type ('CFO Act' | 'Independent'), notes (scope context — keep it
status-neutral, status is derived from dates), sorns (curated SORN identifiers),
extraFilings (notices that exist outside the FR API, e.g. SEC's own PA releases).
Rollup: a doc filed by a child agency is attributed to the nearest ancestor
listed here, else to its top-level parent. FERC is listed here so its notices
are not folded into the Energy Department.

social-security-administration.notes: EO 14249 compliance; added the DNP routine use with the limitation required by 20 CFR 401.150(c).

commodity-futures-trading-commission.notes: Modified 4 SORNs. Also added M-17-12 breach routine uses to 3 of the 4 systems.

education-department.notes: Cites both EO 14249 and M-25-32. Federal Student Aid disbursements are the dominant payment stream in scope.

securities-and-exchange-commission.notes: Modified SEC-06 only, after a comprehensive SORN inventory review per EO 14249 and M-25-32. SEC publishes Privacy Act releases on sec.gov rather than solely through the Federal Register.

extraFilings.title: Privacy Act of 1974; System of Records (SEC-06)
extraFilings.action: Notice of a modified system of records

general-services-administration.notes: DNP added as 'Routine Use k'. Also added Congressional disclosure and breach uses. Pegasys was re-acquired from USDA in 2023.

sorns: LOCCS — Line of Credit Control System (A67)
housing-and-urban-development-department.notes: The most active filer in the dataset. Initial notice covered 7 SORNs and removed a prior DNP routine use from the Single Family Mortgage Insurance Origination System. Acting CPO: Shalanda Capehart.

sorns: DOT/ALL 8 — Parking and Transit Benefit Records (TRANServe TSP)
transportation-department.notes: SORN renamed from 'Parking and Transit Benefit System'. Migrated to FedRAMP-authorized cloud; SSNs no longer collected.

peace-corps.notes: Added as 'Routine Use O' to the Peace Corps General Routine Use list.

federal-energy-regulatory-commission.notes: 16 SORNs in a single consolidated notice. CIO & SAOP: Mittal Desai. Listed separately from the Energy Department, which files on its own.

agriculture-department.notes: Extensive payment programs — SNAP, farm subsidies, rural development loans. VA BEP data already reaches USDA via PARIS for eligibility checks. Files through components including FNS and the Farm Service Agency / Commodity Credit Corporation.

commerce-department.notes: Includes NOAA, Census, USPTO, and NIST — multiple components with grant and contractor payment SORNs in scope.

defense-department.notes: Largest federal agency by disbursement. DFAS is a Non-Treasury Disbursing Office handling $477B+/year across Army, Navy, Air Force, and the defense agencies.

energy-department.notes: Grants, national labs, and contractor payments. Its component FERC is tracked as a separate line.

health-and-human-services-department.notes: Highest improper payment exposure of any agency — CMS alone administers Medicare and Medicaid. Component SORNs span CMS, NIH, CDC, HRSA, SAMHSA, and ACF.

homeland-security-department.notes: Includes FEMA disaster relief payments, CBP, and ICE. FEMA improper payments are a historically significant federal issue.

interior-department.notes: Mineral royalties, tribal trust payments, and natural resource grants via BLM, BIA, NPS, and BSEE.

justice-department.notes: OJP grants, BOP vendor payments, and law enforcement assistance programs with significant payment volume.

labor-department.notes: UI program improper payments are a major long-standing federal problem; employment and training grants are also in scope. DOL has pursued both SORN modifications and PIIA computer matching programs against the DNP Working System.

state-department.notes: Foreign assistance payments, contractor payments abroad, and consular services, with a unique cross-border compliance context.

treasury-department.notes: Operates DNP itself through the Bureau of the Fiscal Service, and must also comply as a disclosing agency. IRS and BFS have extensive SORN inventories in scope.

veterans-affairs-department.notes: VA BEP database designated into DNP/PARIS (Sep. 2025) for state use. VA must also modify its own SORNs as a disclosing agency; VBA and VHA payments are massive in scale.

environmental-protection-agency.notes: Grants and cooperative agreements to states and tribes; grantee and contractor payment records in scope.

national-aeronautics-and-space-administr.notes: Large contractor payment base. SEWP and other acquisition vehicles involve substantial vendor and awardee payment records.

nuclear-regulatory-commission.notes: Smaller, fee-funded agency. Contractor and grant payment records are limited in scope relative to other CFO Act agencies.

national-science-foundation.notes: Primarily a grant-making agency — awardee, PI, and institution records are highly relevant to DNP screening.

personnel-management-office.notes: Administers federal retirement and FEHB, among the largest benefit payment programs subject to DNP. CSRS/FERS and health plan records are directly implicated.

small-business-administration.notes: Loan guarantee and disaster assistance programs had massive COVID-era improper payments, making SBA a primary target for DNP screening.

agency-for-international-development.notes: Undergoing major restructuring. Foreign assistance payments carry a unique compliance context and the operational timeline is uncertain.
